## The problem

What are you trying to do that the tool does not let you do today? Describe the
need, not just the feature. A clear problem is easier to solve well than a
pre-chosen solution.

## What you have in mind

If you have an idea for how it could work, describe it. Labels, config, and
behavior are all fair game.

## Does it fit the tool

Each tool has a scope, and it drives a proven backend rather than reimplementing
it. Say why this belongs in the tool rather than in the backend it drives or in a
different tool in the suite. If you are not sure, ask anyway and we will work it
out.

## Alternatives

Anything you have already tried or considered, and why it fell short.
